subject: Hospitality
title: Gig Economy Meets Hospitality
description: Learn Gig Economy Meets Hospitality in one minute.

hook.text: Hotels are hiring gig workers for shifts—like Uber for housekeeping. Platforms like Qwick and Instawork make it instant.

buildup.text: A hotel short on banquet staff posts a shift by 8 AM. By 10 AM, three vetted gig workers accept and show up ready.

discovery.text: Gig platforms cut hiring time from weeks to hours. Hotels fill gaps without permanent headcount commitments.

twist.text: Gig workers lack institutional knowledge. They don't know the hotel's culture, regulars, or hidden quirks of the building.

climax.text: The hybrid model is winning: a core team owns culture and guest relationships; gig workers plug volume gaps.

punchline.text: Core team for soul. Gig workers for scale. Hospitality's new workforce blend.

quiz.question: What is the main downside of gig workers in hotels?
options: They lack institutional knowledge about the hotel's culture and regulars
